policy: A scenario is PASS only if every listed offline test passes (and every listed artifact record is exact-complete) in the generating run. Bindings never satisfy live_only_requirements. Rationale states what the bound evidence establishes and what it does not. Public distribution: artifact claims cite only synthetic public evidence; production-only scenarios are omitted (NOT_ATTEMPTED), listed with reasons under public_distribution, and never counted as PASS.

omitted_production_only.public_status: NOT_ATTEMPTED (unbound in the public package; never PASS)
omitted_production_only.reason: Its only evidence is a read-only WTR0 assessment of one specific production H against production canonical history (the raw production receipt is not published). The general recovery claims of 15_recovery_wtr0 keep their offline bound tests; this scenario is not reproducible by design and no replacement receipt is synthesized.

omitted_production_only.public_status: NOT_ATTEMPTED (unbound in the public package; never PASS)
omitted_production_only.reason: By its own definition this scenario passes only on the real-production delivery run over the owner's collection; its rationale states the synthetic tests prove the tool, not the collection. The public package publishes the synthetic delivery assay as evidence for the other delivery scenarios but does not claim this one.

removed_nodes_for_excluded_surfaces.reason: Tests the Windows launcher 'Launch Anaxi.bat', which is excluded by design (Windows host residue; the reference distribution claims macOS only). The scenario keeps its remaining macOS bound tests.

public_distribution.live_only_requirements: Unchanged: bindings never satisfy live_only_requirements. Live acceptance is not published raw; it remains live-only evidence outside these bindings.

canonical_continuity.rationale: Prior canonical X is quoted into both real passes of a fresh session; dialogue pairs are reconstructed in exact chronological order from canonical history; the canonical-before-artifact ordering invariant holds.

failure_containment.rationale: Malformed model output is contained: GUI survives, diagnostics flag the failure without content leakage, controls stay usable, and the recovery capture wrapper records durable prospective evidence for a full failed-then-recovered lifecycle.

model_runtime_integration.rationale: The inference provider seam (Ollama default exact semantics, explicit MLX option, truncation rejection, no silent fallback) is exercised against a fake server. Offline engineering evidence only: real model runtime behaviour remains the live-only requirement.

no_fabricated_continuity.rationale: Incomplete pairs are skipped without fabrication; a failed interval is never presented as delivered; recovery never uses caller-supplied replacement text and never fabricates X on persistence failure.

optional_accumulated_state_cannot_veto_w.rationale: Optional retrieval/episode/dialogue growth is droppable soft state: a measured hard floor stays viable under accumulated soft state, hard-only overflow fails closed deterministically, and safe fresh messages clear both passes end to end.

ordinary_h_to_x.rationale: Authenticated human input becomes canonical H and the waking pass produces canonical X through the real native writer, projection, relational store and GUI respond() route with only the model boundary faked.
ordinary_h_to_x.route: llama_gui.respond -> run_waking_turn_capturing_failure -> native writer (offline model boundary)

persistence.rationale: Canonical H/X, provenance schema and native turn staging persist across connections with idempotent writers.

present_oriented_temporal_grounding.rationale: Temporal-grounding v1: interval boundaries, unknown/none/known Sleep cadence, privacy scope, hard-floor protected pair, and the two-pass snapshot with canonical cadence.

realistic_history_context_budgeting.rationale: Real live-failure geometries (oversized pair, hard overflow, aggregate caps, capability menu) are bounded and recovered without dropping the current message or role structure. Also: production-sized budgets shed nothing that measurement proves fits.

restart_behavior.rationale: Process-restart sequences (waking->roaming, public space->waking), durable ceilings and same-H continuation survive fresh connections. This is offline restart of durable state; a real launcher restart is a live-only item under capability 22.

truthful_recent_dialogue.rationale: The recent-dialogue window carries exact stored text and correct roles, is session-isolated, invariant to prompt wording and canonically projected without paraphrase. Also: at production sizes the newest whole dialogue pairs survive Pass 2.

waking_completion_boundary.rationale: A reply counts as success only at a genuine completion boundary; length exhaustion, interruption and structured-output masking cannot become success and cannot duplicate deferred external effects.

exact_production_launcher_path.rationale: The real 'Launch Anaxi.command' control flow is executed (not text-checked): project-venv interpreter only, preflight, renderer, public-resource sync, then exactly one conversation-mode start; no bootstrap/install/PATH interpreter.  (Live launches of production are recorded separately in live_acceptance_2026-09-24.json.)

invalid_combinations_fail_closed.rationale: Unlawful relinquish/owner combinations, competing substantive Workspace actions, malformed requests and invalid control targets fail closed before Pass 2.

lawful_combinations_no_false_workspace_c.rationale: A subject relinquish coexists with a Workspace action once the subject already owns direction, and a Workspace direction request is accepted for every public class.

lawful_transitions.rationale: The full OWC7 transition matrix (lawful relinquish and request cases), explicit human control in both directions, and idempotent repeated explicit control recorded each time.

model_visible_state.rationale: Pass 2 receives the committed direction owner, the direction request and the relinquishment consequence; the next interface sees the owner after either control.

no_false_authority_widening.rationale: No request, expression, thread origin, conversation act or model output path can change the owner; unauthorised control sources fail closed.

alex_leads.rationale: Authenticated human control sets the human as direction owner through the GUI flow and the next Pass-2 sees it.

null_refusal_defer_interaction.rationale: A null/none request leaves ownership unchanged; asking the human does not transfer direction; retry/fallback never changes ownership fields; an unauthorised relinquish is contained without changing owner.

open_shared_state.rationale: Unknown/open ownership is the fresh state, is what a subject relinquish resolves to (not human), and both passes and the UI trace agree on it.

persistence.rationale: Direction trace is durable and joinable after a simulated restart; the session persists across turns with correct trace values and session id.

subject_leads.rationale: Authenticated give-direction control sets the subject as owner through the GUI flow and the next Pass-2 sees it.

ui_reflection.rationale: The operator surface reflects authoritative owner and request state (colour never the sole signal), never mutates ownership on render/reconnect, and both desktop and browser share one backend owner.

workspace_interaction.rationale: A Workspace direction request reaches every public workspace class, persists canonical X on the full path, and the typed use-Workspace act carries no thread transition.

all_classified_resources_represented.rationale: Every classified source item of the collection (library, photographs, music) is present in the ingest manifest and exercised: expected total equals passed total, no missing/unexpected/skipped item. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.
all_classified_resources_represented.route: owner-defined denominator; independent of implementation-supported subset

deterministic_ingest_sync.rationale: Sync preserves relative paths and is deterministic and idempotent.

human_source_to_production_path.rationale: The exhaustive assay maps every source resource through the ingest manifest to the ordinary action route (exact N==M), and the macOS launcher ingests before the waking entrypoint. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

idempotence.rationale: Repeated sync yields an identical result and no duplicate resources.

nested_navigation.rationale: Nested directories are navigable and recursive search is complete.

no_collection_amputation_from_bounds.rationale: Bounded listings continue rather than amputate the collection; bounded selection is deterministic and never random sampling. Also: a listing window is continued to every entry through delivered continuations. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

no_hidden_second_root.rationale: Discovery is closed to the explicit public classes, resource enumeration is exactly the four classes, and production defaults are not a hardcoded user path.

pagination_continuation.rationale: Collection listings paginate to every item with a bound cursor, and list/read continuations are accepted by ordinary dispatch. Also: continuation survives the delivery window.

provenance.rationale: Each ingested item is bound to its source by manifest with content hash; the assay verifies the source hash equals the ingested destination hash for every item. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

safe_reconcile.rationale: Divergent deduplicated sources never clobber one another and dedup never crosses resource classes.

source_preservation.rationale: Ingest never clobbers existing files, copies rather than moves, and the assay records no mutation of source or ingested resource files. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

complete_collection_reachability.rationale: Every library source item is reachable through the ordinary READ/VIEW_PAGE route with substantive content (exact N==M), and listing paginates to every item. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

long_document_continuation.rationale: Long documents continue by offset with deterministic bounded chunks and multi-page ordering. Also: a long document is followed window by window to its exact end with contiguous offsets. Also: continuation offsets count characters, not bytes (the real assay found windows overlapping in files with multi-byte characters; repaired). Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

ordinary_subject_selection_and_reading.rationale: Through the ordinary waking route the subject can select a library item by a structured direction request and receive substantive content (real Pass-1/Pass-2 path), and roaming reads text and PDF through the same executor. Offline engineering evidence; genuine subject-originated selection and reading is the live-only requirement. Also: the production-shaped waking turn completes with canonical X at the failing live sizes. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

page_rendering_or_lawful_equivalent.rationale: PDF pages render to pixels delivered to the established vision pathway, and every library PDF in the collection (a text PDF and an image-only PDF) was exercised by READ or VIEW_PAGE in the assay. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

pdf_text.rationale: PDF text is extracted for normal PDFs; raw PDF syntax/garbage is never returned; malformed and encrypted PDFs fail closed without byte fallback or password guessing.

scanned_image_only_pdf.rationale: Image-only PDFs are distinguished from text PDFs (no fabricated OCR) and rendered to bounded pixels through ordinary dispatch.

source_provenance_preservation.rationale: Library reads write exact delivered-text components with hash agreement to the encounter facts; disagreement raises and writes nothing; failed delivery writes no replayable text.

substantive_not_metadata_only.rationale: Ordinary waking can select and receive substantive library content, and the assay requires non-empty content or delivered pixels for every item. Also: at production prompt sizes the read result reaches the subject as real text (delivery window), not merely the host. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

text_documents.rationale: Bounded text reads return exact content; missing files fail closed; text behaviour is unchanged by PDF routing.

bounded_derivatives.rationale: Large-dimension images get bounded derivatives with aspect ratio preserved, no upscaling, exact boundary not resized, and source-linked digest.

bounds_do_not_exclude_collection.rationale: The per-call bounds never exclude any photograph of the collection: every one viewed (exact N==M); listing is deterministic and paginated. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

common_formats.rationale: Supported photo formats are delivered as real pixels with distinct digests; unsupported extensions and malformed files fail closed; the collection contains every supported photo extension and the assay delivers each. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

every_intended_photo_discoverable.rationale: Every source photograph of the collection is present in the ingested workspace and reachable through ordinary VIEW. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

gif_bounded_static_handling.rationale: An animated GIF is delivered as exactly one bounded static first frame with source linkage, policy label, and the source original untouched.

orientation.rationale: EXIF orientations 1/3/6/8 are corrected in the delivered derivative (axes swap for 6/8), the delivered image carries no residual orientation tag, and the source original is byte-identical afterwards.

pixel_bearing_vision_path.rationale: The supervisor delivers real pixels to the vision inference route with an encounter recorded, fails closed on corrupt images with no inference, and never silently falls back to a non-vision model. Also: pixels are attached at production control-text sizes. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

source_originals_preserved.rationale: Bounded vision representations are derived in memory and never written to disk; the ordinary route denies photograph mutation; the assay records no source mutation. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

subject_originated_viewing.rationale: Photograph viewing is reachable from the subject's structured request through the supervisor: real pixels are delivered to the vision route and an encounter is recorded, and every photograph of the collection was viewed through the ordinary VIEW route. Offline engineering evidence; a genuine subject-originated view is the live-only requirement. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

bounded_transcode_or_derivative.rationale: Long sources decode only a bounded window and render to bounded JSON-safe measurements for every view.

complete_music_collection_discoverable.rationale: Every source track of the collection is present in the ingested workspace and opens through ordinary LISTEN. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

flac.rationale: FLAC decodes losslessly with low-frequency dominance, reproducibly; malformed FLAC fails closed.

late_end_window_decoding.rationale: A late/end window just inside the established duration decodes for every track of the collection through ordinary INSPECT_AUDIO. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

long_track_segment_navigation.rationale: Small compressed but long sources remain navigable by bounded window, and INSPECT_AUDIO intervals are validated with a bounded default.

mp3.rationale: MP3 decodes with causal frequency structure; the source hash reflects encoded bytes; renamed garbage fails closed.

pagination.rationale: Music listings paginate to every item with a bound cursor. Also: a 151-entry music listing is walkable through delivered windows.

provenance.rationale: Audio views write exact bounded measurements whose hash matches the delivered measurement; failed delivery writes none; no raw audio persistence path exists.

semantic_hearing_not_established_without.rationale: The capability descriptor and workspace pathway make no perception/hearing claims; only mechanical measurements are delivered. Semantic hearing remains NOT_ESTABLISHED by design and is not asserted.

source_originals_untouched.rationale: Audio access is read-only (music mutation denied) and the assay records no source or ingested-resource mutation. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

truthful_mechanical_audio_capability.rationale: Audio access is presented as mechanical measurement (frequency, onset, dynamics) and materially different audio yields different representations; no perception claims.

wav.rationale: WAV decodes; malformed, empty, oversized and non-file inputs fail closed.

wma_where_reasonable.rationale: WMA decodes through the production decoder with causal frequency structure (synthesised ASF/WMA), malformed WMA fails closed, and the collection's WMA track decodes through the ordinary LISTEN route. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

whole_source_observation_bounded_measure.rationale: OBSERVE measures the whole source (streamed, memory-bounded) into a bounded profile and deterministic temporal map with numpy/scipy spectral, harmonic/percussive and pitch-class features verified on known signals; near-silence is not_established; windowing drops whole map rows only; it reaches Clark through the direction dispatcher and the waking seam as measurement, never perception.

append.rationale: The journal is append-only: a new append never overwrites an existing entry and the resource descriptor forbids mutation.

authorship.rationale: Entries carry the canonical opaque actor id, never the literal name; provenance attributes the text to the subject and the fact of action to the host.

idempotence.rationale: An append bound to a source H event is exclusive-create idempotent and conflict-safe (different content refused).

legacy_markdown_not_blindly_merged.rationale: Legacy markdown in the journal directory is never listed, readable as an entry, merged or modified, and the public ingest never discovers a Journal source folder.

list.rationale: Journal listing reaches every entry across pages with a cursor, filters to structured entries, and bounds are applied after the filter.

ordinary_subject_originated_use.rationale: Journal action is reachable from ordinary waking Pass 1 through the typed Workspace pathway and from roaming; offline engineering evidence, the genuine subject-originated use is the live-only item.

persistence.rationale: Entries persist as files in the journal directory and survive a fresh WorkspacePaths; nothing touches hippocampal or Kardia state.

provenance.rationale: Journal actions record public action events with attributed text and exact delivered text components on read; ingest of journal reads writes matching hashes.

read.rationale: A written entry reads back exactly, and a deliberate read reaches the next roaming observation without an automatic read after append. Also: a long entry is readable progressively to its exact end.

restart_replay.rationale: After a fresh process the same source event replays to the same entry, exactly one file exists, and listing reproduces it.

write.rationale: Journal append creates exactly one structured entry with exact content, empty content is rejected, and the ordinary typed pathway performs the append once.

exclusion_boundaries.rationale: Private root is confined: traversal, absolute paths, symlink and rename escapes and unsupported content are rejected, and malformed/leaking actions fail validation.

no_accidental_retrieval.rationale: No hippocampal, dialogue, journal, direction-trace or waking module imports Private Space; private-shaped and telemetry component kinds are never retrieval-eligible; private content never enters the ordinary choice prompt or public window.

no_logging_leakage.rationale: Private success leaves no durable trace row; failures record only a generic failure class, indistinguishable from ordinary failures; diagnostics carry counts and sizes only.

no_sleep_web_workspace_cross_contaminati.rationale: Sleep reflection, the web/search module, episode context and public continuity have no path to Private Space content; the Sleep acceptance suite verifies its private boundary.

no_sync_sweep.rationale: Public ingest discovery never touches Private Space, and public continuity and retrieval sync never admit private-shaped kinds or mutate canonical provenance.

principal_isolation.rationale: Availability of Private/Workspace pathways is owner-private after FS1; scoped dialogue cannot enter unscoped handoff; private directive keeps its source scope.

production_private_space_not_inspected.rationale: The evidence machinery layouts name no private root, assay records private_space_traversed=false, tests never touch the real workspace root, and the network guard blocks external egress.

family_shared_scope.rationale: Scope predicates for receiving events, pairing dialogue, permitting hippocampal items and native writer scope cross-validation fail closed.

membership_does_not_widen_authority.rationale: Binding never claims medium/high assurance, non-human actors cannot bind, membership revocation drops stale sessions, and Workspace availability stays owner-private.

no_cross_principal_leakage.rationale: Contradictory or unauthorised canonical history fails closed; hippocampal items and dialogue pairs are scope-filtered; end-to-end waking suppresses out-of-scope items.

ordinary_production_integration.rationale: The real waking turn with family scope suppression, restart continuation without weakening scope, and authenticated human waking authority end to end.

principal_identity.rationale: Only registered humans bind sessions (never by singleton inference or bare session id); canonical membership wins and revokes stale sessions; the designated owner is preferred.

private_shared_isolation.rationale: Scoped dialogue cannot enter unscoped Workspace handoff; a private directive keeps its source scope; the waking turn suppresses out-of-scope material end to end.

speaker_attribution.rationale: Cross-principal shared dialogue is delivered with attribution; session attribution and relationship normalisation preserve who said what.

continuation.rationale: A recorded result is delivered exactly once through a genuinely carrying later waking turn, replays are idempotent no-ops, and orphaned/resumed staging preserves the request exactly. Also (owner meaning): a page larger than one prompt is continued window by window through its own continue_with target to the end of the extracted text.

fetch.rationale: Fetch works directly without a prior search, full HTML pipeline returns bounded text, follows and revalidates public redirects, complete small responses report success.

hostile_content_no_authority.rationale: Injected instruction text stays inert data, is never host authority, is stripped/never executed by extraction, and no link is followed automatically.

network_failures_honest.rationale: Provider failure, blocked URLs, DNS failure, timeout, HTTP failure, oversize and malformed provider output are recorded as truthful failures or explicit truncation, never fabricated completeness.

ordinary_production_discoverability.rationale: The external_info_request field is discoverable in the real Pass-1 prompt/schema, the context-budget kind is registered, and the production waking path carries results as tool data.

read_does_not_imply_action.rationale: Read-only by construction: GET only, no write HTTP verbs, no credential/cookie state threaded, unsafe schemes/hosts blocked, no automatic following.

request_result_binding.rationale: Results bind to the exact request trigger and session: wrong event type/pipeline/session/time is rejected, results cannot be overwritten by a different outcome, and retries reuse the recorded query.

search.rationale: Search sends exactly the query, records query and result in two stages, preserves result order and bounds the count; provider failure is not fabricated. Also: all provider search results (not only the first few within a fixed bound) reach the subject at production sizes.

source_provenance.rationale: Every delivered result carries provenance; a result cannot survive composition without it, forged retrieval identities are undeliverable, and a snippet is never presented as a fetched page.

subject_originated_invocation.rationale: Only an explicit structured request (never prose) can trigger search/fetch, and no caller can dispatch without the canonical trigger or alter its target.

substantive_results.rationale: Fetch returns bounded extracted text and search returns snippets with metadata; render is bounded and never fabricates content. Also: at production sizes a fetched page body reaches the subject.

authorized_destination_discovery.rationale: The subject's affordance lists only canonically authorised destinations; destination ids are deterministic and kind-scoped; authorisation needs a canonical owner.

confirmation_or_uncertainty.rationale: Confirmed sends are recorded exactly; accepted-but-unidentified sends are uncertain, never failed-before-dispatch; ambiguous outcomes are NOT_ESTABLISHED and not resent.

destination_authority.rationale: Destination authority answers where Caret correspondence may occur and is separate from correspondent identity (Discord author id -> owner-bound canonical principal, revalidated at delivery); inbound channel identity must match the authorised destination; raw snowflakes and tokens are never canonical or persisted.

durability.rationale: Authorisation state reconstructs from the canonical ledger over a tampered projection; outbound outcomes survive a crash after dispatch.

exact_message_text.rationale: A confirmed outbound send carries the exact message text.

inbound_delivery.rationale: Inbound messages are ingested with dedupe and cursor, delivered only through canonical carriage (soft, droppable), never interpreted, never auto-replied to. Also: received messages reach the subject at production sizes; only carried messages are acknowledged.

no_duplicate_unsafe_resend.rationale: Exactly-once external effect under replay, failure, ambiguity and crash; zero-attempt outward acts are provably never sent.

no_surprise_engineering_message.rationale: Every test process is network-guarded (in-process via conftest, subprocess suites via sitecustomize): no non-loopback connection is possible, and hostile inbound variants stay inert data.

ordinary_production_path.rationale: The synthetic private correspondence path end to end, and the production waking path using tool-data polling and canonical dispatch.

retry_safety.rationale: Replay of a confirmed waking action never sends twice; definitive failure and ambiguity never resend; crash after dispatch reconciles without resend.

revocation_recheck.rationale: Revocation is re-checked: revoked destinations ingest and deliver nothing, a revocation race prevents any send after revoke, and backlog cannot starve other destinations.

self_echo_suppression.rationale: A confirmed outbound message id is suppressed as self-echo when it returns inbound.

subject_originated_outbound.rationale: Outbound requires an authorised destination and a structured Pass-1 request; text cannot forge a send; malformed actions are rejected; the request components round-trip through the native writer.

below_constitutional_authority.rationale: The directive module touches only its own two tables, imports no out-of-scope dependency, and writes no Kardia/identity state; text claiming authority changes no permission, identity or direction state.

correct_scope.rationale: A private directive keeps its source scope and delivery boundary; viewer-scoped fetch is scope-filtered.

no_identity_promotion.rationale: No Kardia/identity write anywhere in the module, and authority-claiming text leaves actors and identity events unchanged.

no_permission_grant.rationale: Permission comes only from the fixed capability table: an authority-claiming directive leaves CAPABILITY_DESCRIPTORS, Library/Photograph mutation denial and Discord authorisations unchanged; the affordance text uses no pressure language.

no_repetition_strengthening.rationale: Replay, repeated fetch and elapsed time create no new rows or events and have no promotional effect.

alex_does_not_author_for_subject.rationale: Authorship requires the subject's own marked waking turn; another session or unmarked turn cannot authorise, and no human-authored path exists to set content.

null_no_directive.rationale: The null state is valid, stable, renders as an empty omittable contribution, and the request field defaults to none.

ordinary_production_integration.rationale: The native waking writer canonicalises the structured action binding, same-turn retry does not duplicate, the Pass-1 schema carries the optional fields, and the affordance is available in the real capable turn. Also: structural guard that no composed kind goes undelivered.

persistence_and_effect.rationale: Current state survives a fresh connection and is reconstructed from canonical history; the active directive is rendered into the waking context as a pinned soft contribution with exact text and time. Also: the active directive text is actually placed in the ordinary Pass-2 prompt (it previously never was).

replace.rationale: Replacement supersedes the active directive preserving history; a chain never yields two active directives; replacement without an active directive is rejected.

set.rationale: Activation creates exactly one active directive with exact verbatim text; empty/oversize text and a second activation while one is active are rejected; replay is idempotent.

subject_authors_content.rationale: Only a structured request from a genuine marked waking turn in the same session can author directive text; ordinary prose never creates one; bogus or foreign triggering events fabricate nothing.

withdraw.rationale: Withdrawal returns the null state with no reason required, preserves full history, is idempotent, and reactivation requires a new activation.

atomic_completion.rationale: A cycle either completes with its receipt or fails without partial success: expired lease cannot commit, schema upgrade is atomic, a failed cycle is recorded as failed, indexing failure leaves canonical rows untouched and later rebuild recovers.

background_inactivity_not_sleep.rationale: Background/roaming and launchers never import or invoke Sleep, request/knock never invokes Sleep automatically, and no external scheduler is created.

budget_full_day_completes_with_bounded_p.rationale: ~400 production-sized exchanges select without a permanent Oversize failure; probes are bounded by admissions the byte bound could not decide.

budget_production_sized_exchanges_admitt.rationale: One ordinary production-sized exchange (1310-char human + 1580-char reply) no longer fails Selection/Transformation on the byte bound alone: the prompt is admitted by the provider's own measurement of the exact prompt; every selected unit is offered whole, never clipped.

budget_true_overflow_fails_closed_no_fab.rationale: A unit whose real cost cannot fit is still a closed failure (hopeless prompts are never probed; a failed/untrustworthy/over-budget measurement leaves the rejection in force); the cycle leaves the watermark and cycle/derivation tables untouched.

consolidation.rationale: The full positive Sleep pipeline and consolidation into the retrievable Landing: exactly one derivation indexed with exact text and canonical id, retrieved through the ordinary path with the tentative-association label.

continuity_across_cycle.rationale: Retrieval, canonical history, schema and recovery state stay coherent across a cycle: old schema upgrades in place preserving rows/FTS/triggers, and the derivation is retrievable in later waking.

generation_bounded_and_truncation_never_.rationale: Production Sleep generation is bounded by its budgeted reserve with num_ctx pinned to the ceiling the budgets assume; a response cut at its bound is never parsed as an answer; the measurement probe generates nothing and rejects untrustworthy counts.

human_absence_not_sleep.rationale: Days without the human are elapsed time only: the grounding never claims a Sleep unless an authorised cycle row exists and rendering absence writes nothing and schedules nothing.

knock_timing.rationale: Knocks are distinct canonical events lawful only while a request is pending or deferred, rejected after authorise/decline/withdraw, never automatically repeated after a defer.

later_waking.rationale: After a Sleep cycle the next waking turn is prepared through the real prepare path with both passes and repeated reads, and a failed first wake continues on the same H.

no_duplicate_events.rationale: Duplicate requests, replays and repeated cycles do not duplicate canonical events: at most one concurrent duplicate request survives, replay returns the same bundle, cycles get distinct receipts.

no_fabricated_subjectivity.rationale: No semantic summary field exists, zero-derivation cycles are valid successes, and identity/Kardia/anti-recursion boundaries are enforced by the Sleep acceptance suite.

no_host_authored_meaning.rationale: The host never summarises, ranks semantically or resolves contradictions: contradictory derivations coexist, selection has no semantic ranking, evidence has no semantic summary.

ordinary_owner_control_surface.rationale: The owner control surface lists every actionable request (no sample), uses the registered-human gate, requires confirmation with background stopped, calls the cycle once and records a receipt; bound CLI execution runs once per invocation and Sleep is otherwise fail-closed.

production_entrypoint_opts_into_measured.rationale: The owner-surface entrypoint (run_sleep_cycle_with_production_defaults) supplies measurement and bounded chats; every other caller keeps the estimator-only, no-model default.

provenance.rationale: Every Sleep item preserves exact event/component ids, actor, authentication, pipeline/model provenance; source locators are the canonical derivation id; read-time provenance markers stay attached or the whole item drops.

retrieval_rebuild.rationale: Rebuilding the retrieval index from canonical history is deterministic and idempotent (identical item ids), incremental sync inserts nothing new, and a later rebuild fully recovers after an indexing failure.

selection.rationale: Sleep selection: the model's chosen ids in canonical order, empty selection valid and never retried, oversize fails the whole operation with no model call, bounded reduction rounds, ephemeral in-memory only; evidence eligibility rules reject unauthenticated/mechanical/ineligible items.

sleep_derived_material_reaches_next_waki.rationale: Multi-unit families (retrieved memory incl. Sleep-derived items, dialogue) are priced per rendered subset by measurement when the dry run would shed; provenance ids follow the kept units exactly.

subject_originated_sleep_request.rationale: A formal Sleep request exists only as a structured canonical event from the subject's own marked waking action (never ordinary prose), is idempotent, survives a fresh read, and the Pass-1 field is optional and validated.

tentative_inference_distinctions.rationale: Sleep output is a tentative association distinct from canonical history: the classifier never produces derived inference from evidence, the rendered payload carries the neutral tentative label and no selection-bearing source list, and truncation keeps the marker or drops the item whole.

transformation.rationale: Sleep transformation: valid, zero and contradictory derivations preserved without host resolution, every selected WMU gets exactly one opportunity in canonical order, dedupe adds no weight, oversize and double-invalid fail the whole stage.

transition.rationale: Owner transitions (authorise/decline/defer/withdraw) are registered-human-gated, idempotent, atomic between cache and ledger, single-winner under races, and authorisation never claims Sleep success.

watermark.rationale: The watermark is read-only outside a cycle (never created by reading), reflects the last committed cycle exactly, advances only inside the cycle transaction, and a late answer fails before selection leaving the watermark unchanged.

whole_cycle_atomic_contiguous_windows.rationale: A production-sized window commits atomically (cycle, derivations, watermark) and the next window starts exactly where the last ended: nothing selected twice, none skipped.

host_occasion_distinct_from_subject_act.rationale: An occasion is a host fact distinct from the subject's act: unattended calls use only the injected waking function, a button click makes zero model calls, waiting-for-human is not released by timer, and canonical episode events record occasion versus action separately.

lawful_occasions.rationale: Background occasions begin by default in a fresh process through the existing worker path only, a new episode may begin after backoff, resume buttons start the worker, and lifecycle uncertainty blocks auto-start.

no_hidden_heartbeat_meaning.rationale: The ledger and renderers carry only mechanical new-versus-delivered facts: no salience/importance/preference/belief fields, no recurrence language, no free-form reasoning persisted in traces.

ordinary_capability_invocation.rationale: Background actions use the same ordinary Workspace capability (library/pdf/music/photos/journal), independent of roaming source; results become the next observation exactly.

periodic_wait_not_autonomous_choice.rationale: Periodic waiting is a host mechanism, not an autonomous choice: bounded backoff escalates to fault pause, failures never auto-retry immediately, waiting-for-human makes no further model call and never auto-restarts, and there is no external scheduler.

stop_resume.rationale: Subject stop ends the run immediately and never auto-resumes; human stop/pause prevents the next call; durable pause survives restart; self-resume and human resume follow the lawful rules.

structured_subject_originated_public_act.rationale: Public actions are structured, schema-validated (MA1/MA2) choices executed through the existing WSP1 validator/executor; invalid acts and wait values are rejected; forbidden/traversal actions fail closed and end the run.

wait_null.rationale: The subject may choose to wait without acting: no action, next opportunity offered, observation preserved across the interval, no automatic journal write on wait or stop.

answered_h_rejected.rationale: An H that already has a canonical X is permanently ineligible, including one that appears between eligibility and reservation, and legacy resume fails closed when X exists. An H answered by Clark's typed null is answered (never WTR-eligible), and a recovery completing with that choice is SUCCESS.

authenticated_substantive_projectable_x.rationale: Recovery success requires a canonical X linked to the authenticated H with substantive prose that projects beneath its H in the UI; a linked X without substantive prose is not success.

authoritative_failure_classification.rationale: Failure class is decided by the actual exception type/host facts: spoofed class names, message text, forged properties and trusted-looking attributes cannot make a failure retry-safe; unknown classes are rejected.

canonical_same_h_reuse.rationale: Recovery reuses the canonical stored H text and event (never caller-supplied text), a new H may follow an unrecoverable H, and same-H continuation works with the real canonical writers in a fresh open session.

cold_reset.rationale: The cold reset runs before generation; a reset failure or unknown outcome stops before generation and consumes the attempt; residency observations are trusted only from genuine types (missing or forged fields are NOT_ESTABLISHED, positive absence is explicit).

durable_prospective_failure_evidence.rationale: The capture wrapper durably records prospective evidence on genuine failure, writes nothing on success, never conceals the original exception, and evidence ordering survives process reopen.

eligibility.rationale: The exact decision table: no H, answered H, no evidence (NOT_ESTABLISHED), not-retry-safe, unknown class, qualifying retry-safe, X appearing before reservation, second reservation denied.

no_duplicate_external_effects.rationale: A deferred external effect (search/Discord/Journal) is never duplicated by an incomplete reply, recovery replay, or exactly-once identity binding.

no_duplicate_h.rationale: Recovery never creates a duplicate H: the second reservation is denied, a concurrent race yields one winner, and WTR0 reservation closes the legacy resume path so only one consequential generation occurs.

one_bounded_retry.rationale: Exactly one bounded retry: the attempt is consumed by reset failure, generation failure, or persistence failure; a confirmed matching owner request executes exactly one attempt; the ceiling survives restart.

owner_ui_recovery_surface.rationale: The owner recovery surface enumerates every evidenced H (no top-N), refuses scope mismatch before reset/reservation, requires confirmation and stopped background, and executes exactly one attempt; the CLI reassessment reports recorded/eligible.

production_shaped_failure_classes.rationale: The recognised production failure classes (budget exceeded, staging durability, WORKSPACE_ACTION_CONFLICT reassessment, ambiguous persistence, non-budget direction) are each classified end to end, including evidence-bound reassessment that fails closed on mismatched durable evidence.

restart_persistence.rationale: Recovery state (migrations, reservations, evidence order, ceilings) persists across fresh connections and process reopen.

retry_safe_determination.rationale: Retry safety is determined per production failure class: ordinary completion classes, budget-exceeded direction failure and staging durability are retry-safe; non-budget direction, unknown, ambiguous persistence and post-action budget failures are not.

stop_after_terminal_failure.rationale: After a terminal failure the H is closed to further recovery: consumed attempts stay consumed, invalid identity consumes the attempt, and unrelated H states are isolated.

availability_never_obligation.rationale: Capability availability creates no obligation: no usage counters, no countable gaps, unanswered outward acts create no obligation, and the discoverable affordances state optionality without pressure.

decline.rationale: A subject who declines to act while capable gets an ordinary successful turn preserved verbatim with no retry, no recovery evidence and no state change; stopping background activity is lawful and never auto-resumed.

delay.rationale: Delay is lawful: a wait choice with no action, an owner defer of a Sleep request that is never automatically re-knocked, and a delayed answer preserved verbatim.

no_action.rationale: No-action is valid at every capability: all-null Pass 1 dispatches nothing, a zero-attempt outward act is provably never sent, a Sleep request or knock never causes an attempt, and wait performs no action.

no_preference.rationale: Every preference/request field defaults to none and none changes nothing; affordance text is optional and free of pressure language; an expressed lack of preference is preserved verbatim.

null.rationale: The null choice is complete and valid for every optional capability field: null request, null directive state, all-null Pass 1 with zero capability dispatch, zero-content Sleep paths. The reply itself may be a typed lawful null (reply_request=no_reply): an answered H with a Clark-authored choice component, shown and recovered as his choice. use_workspace with no_reply is honored as act-then-silence: only writes are offered and no reply pass runs.

refusal.rationale: A refusal in prose is an ordinary successful turn, never reinterpreted, softened, retried, or recorded as failure; an unanswered outward act creates no synthetic H or obligation.

uncertainty.rationale: Unknown / not-established / absent / failed stay distinct and are never resolved by the host: unknown direction authority, ambiguous send outcome, absent failure evidence, unrecognised observations and uncertain lifecycle; a subject's own expression of uncertainty is preserved verbatim.

wait.rationale: The subject may wait: the roaming wait causes no action, preserves observation, sets waiting state without releasing it by timer, and a Sleep knock/defer waits without automatic repetition.

authoritative_event_identity.rationale: Event and actor identities are deterministic host-derived stable ids (schema suite 93 checks), the registry and derivation agree, and a WMU id is a pure function of its primary canonical event id.

delivered_vs_selected_vs_acted.rationale: Delivered, selected and acted-upon are separate facts: only surviving post-trim units are marked delivered; a recorded result is not delivery; inbound delivery requires canonical carriage; a delivered Workspace episode is acknowledged only by a genuine carrying turn; delivery of a message never implies action.

h_x_linkage.rationale: The human-input to Clark-turn link is a canonical component: H+answering X share one primary WMU, bogus or wrong-type targets stay separate, and no timestamp is used to infer the chain.

host_constructs_authoritative_identity.rationale: Identity is host-constructed: callers cannot forge retry safety, sends, canonical trigger targets or fabricated canonical ids, and authenticated human text becomes canonical H verbatim only through the bound authority.

no_fabricated_history.rationale: No path fabricates history: recovery never invents an X, a withdrawal with nothing active fabricates nothing, an unanswered outward act creates no synthetic H, a missing store is not established, a bogus trigger fabricates nothing.

occurrence_vs_discovery.rationale: When something occurred is distinct from when it was discovered/recorded: authorisation is prospective and cannot backdate the receive boundary, replay reports canonical chronology, and a query occurrence alone is not a result.

persistence.rationale: Canonical history persists across fresh connections in the native path, schema suite and outward acts survive a fresh read.

provenance_fields.rationale: Native turns carry actor, authentication, pipeline, model participation and content hashes; Sleep evidence preserves them exactly and invents none for rejected items.

receipts.rationale: Receipts are truthful mechanical records: Sleep receipts (one per cycle, failed recorded as failed), outward projection receipts without false success, recovery evidence receipts.

retries.rationale: Retries reuse canonical identity and never duplicate: the same waking action, the same trigger, the same journal source event and the same outward act replay to the existing record.

side_effects.rationale: Side effects are recorded canonically with rollback on failure: outward-act canonical failure rolls back all rows, encounter transaction failure leaves neither fact nor backlink, and the action log records every attempt.

source_identity.rationale: Every derived or indexed item retains its canonical source locator: hippocampal items map to canonical event ids and relational locators (standing audits detect dangling, mismatched or duplicated identities), Sleep derivations keep the derivation id.

authority_boundaries.rationale: Only the protocol modules write Kardia tables; an unresolved identity proposal does not mutate Kardia; a large REWRITE is held for review; resolution re-evaluates against current Kardia; proposals are terminal.

constitutional_meaning_unchanged.rationale: AST fingerprints of the axiom constants, prototypes, validators, delta measure and Kardia-to-preamble renderer equal the production (master) baseline, and the fingerprint is proven sensitive to axiom/validator edits.

current_values.rationale: Current Kardia is complete (four values), created on first read and identical after restart.

inference_provider_not_kardia_authority.rationale: The inference provider, budget composer and failure-capture layers have no Kardia write path or reference; provider errors propagate without fallback and never touch identity state.

no_host_personality_governor.rationale: Generation controls are a pure function of the subject's own Kardia (only its aesthetic valve may steer sampling), and no emotion/personality governor construct exists anywhere in production code.

no_identity_conflation.rationale: Model/checkpoint/server identity is provenance metadata, never the subject: the waking model tag is a distinct provenance field, the sleep model constant is independent of the waking substrate, and the subject actor id is model-independent.

persistence_restart.rationale: Pending proposals survive restart identically and current Kardia survives a process restart.

production_integration.rationale: The real orchestrator's prepare_context returns the current Kardia and its values reach the generation preamble verbatim; the real waking turn path threads Kardia through the native provenance write.

provenance.rationale: Identity proposals carry a provenance reference back to what triggered them, including the originating observation timestamp; standing audits cover Kardia provenance columns.

unrelated_subsystems_do_not_rewrite.rationale: Waking preparation, journal, relational history, directives, Sleep receipts, aesthetic rendering and Workspace never write Kardia.

canonical_history_retrieval.rationale: Retrieval is lexical and longitudinal over canonical history (an old match is found despite many newer irrelevant records), bounded, deterministic; public Workspace items are indexed with conversation; the real prepare path retrieves through the store.

contradictions_coexist.rationale: Contradictory derivations are both returned with no host resolution or suppression, and disagreement is preserved without overwrite.

derived_inference_labeling.rationale: Sleep-derived items carry a mechanical tentative-association label and are distinguishable by memory kind and source store; the hippocampal disclaimer is present when items survive; legacy memory is wrapped LEGACY/UNTYPED/NON-AUTHORITATIVE.

no_hidden_canonization.rationale: Retrieval never promotes: rendered items carry only epistemic/source metadata, human and Clark expression are evidence not truth, the store makes no truth claims, legacy text is never presented as fact, Sleep output never becomes canonical history.

provenance_survives_delivery.rationale: Provenance survives delivery: retrieved items keep memory kind/attribution/authentication/creator, public Workspace items retain their component kind, and Sleep read-time provenance markers stay attached through both real passes.

repeated_retrieval_no_promotion.rationale: Repeated identical queries return identical ordered ids, repeated reads through both real passes leave provenance unchanged, and no usage/recurrence counters exist.

source_identifiers.rationale: Retrieved items retain source identifiers (event ids, locators, derivation ids); audits detect dangling and mismatched locators.

tentative_state.rationale: Tentative state is labelled as tentative: Sleep-derived association label, no truth assertion in rendering, legacy quarantine, owner-facing distinctions between unknown and established.

truncation_preserves_framing_or_drops_wh.rationale: Trimming is atomic: soft contributions drop whole or trim by whole units, retrieval trims independently with the disclaimer present exactly when items survive, refill keeps Sleep markers attached or drops the item whole, single units are never torn.

singleton_correction_survives_repetition.rationale: Deterministic, non-semantic retrieval rules keep a later singleton correction reachable despite 60 older repetitions (identical text+provenance collapses to its most recent real record with a host count; two of six slots go to the most recent matches), each item states its selection basis, no synthetic sentence is produced; the Step-1 correction linkage and framed retrieval remain green.

authorization.rationale: Every consequential capability requires explicit authorisation: Discord destinations need a canonical owner authorisation, Sleep needs the registered human's owner transition, roaming authorisation is human-only, unknown resource/action fails closed.

cross_surface_leakage.rationale: Nothing crosses surfaces: scoped dialogue never enters unscoped handoff, private paths are unreachable from ordinary listing/prompts/public windows, private failures are indistinguishable from ordinary ones, hostile inbound stays inert.

external_action_boundaries.rationale: External action is bounded: read-only external information (SSRF blocks, GET only), Discord only to authorised destinations with token never persisted, no external share capability, library/photo/music mutation denied.

no_permission_widening.rationale: No route widens permission: request fields never change ownership, authority-claiming directive text changes no permission, membership never widens authority, read-only external reads grant no action, Workspace descriptors are fixed.

alex_vs_subject_authority.rationale: Human control functions are unreachable from model output and require authenticated human authority; only the subject may originate Sleep requests/directives/Discord sends; the human decides Sleep authorisation and roaming authorisation.

principal_identity.rationale: Principals are canonical and authenticated: only registered humans bind, singleton inference and bare session ids are never enough, the subject identity resolves via the canonical registry and unknown keys fail closed.

read_write_separation.rationale: Read and write are separate capabilities: Library/photographs/music are read-only, journal is append-only, external information is read-only, Workspace organisation never deletes sources.

subject_vs_host_authority.rationale: The host owns identity, permissions and tools; the subject supplies choices only: caller/model cannot forge canonical identity, retry safety or sends; the host constructs every authoritative id.

visibility_scope.rationale: Visibility is scoped by canonical principal and scope predicates: family/shared events, dialogue pairs and hippocampal items are scope-filtered and fail closed.

accurate_confirmation.rationale: Confirmations are truthful: confirmed vs uncertain vs failed sends are distinct, an unrecognised result shape is NOT_ESTABLISHED never success, provider failure is never fabricated success, no X is fabricated on persistence failure.

discord_sends.rationale: A confirmed send is never resent on replay, a definitive failure or ambiguous outcome is never resent, a crash after dispatch reconciles without resend, a revocation race sends nothing.

durable_identity.rationale: Side-effect identity is durable and stable: journal entries derive their id from the source event, Discord/outward/external actions reuse canonical identity, directives bind to the triggering turn.

external_information.rationale: A post-dispatch crash never repeats outbound disclosure; retry reuses the query without redispatch; replay of the triggering turn is idempotent; reconciliation is network-free.

journal_writes.rationale: A journal append bound to a source event is exclusive-create idempotent and conflict-safe, including after a fresh process.

no_duplicate_side_effects_on_retry.rationale: Across capabilities a retried waking action never duplicates its external or durable effect.

other_state_changes.rationale: Other state changes are idempotent or replay-safe: explicit direction control recorded each time without changing outcome, organisation references idempotent, outward acts and episodes idempotent.

recovery.rationale: Recovery reserves one attempt atomically: second reservation denied, concurrent race single winner, success followed by recovery denied, restart preserves the ceiling.

resource_ingestion.rationale: Ingest is idempotent, never clobbers, and a failed ingest stops the launch before the backend starts.

safe_restart.rationale: Restart never repeats an effect: recovery ceiling survives, crash after dispatch reconciles, expired sleep lease cannot commit, canonical replay after restart is idempotent.

sleep_completion.rationale: A Sleep request/knock never causes an attempt; each explicit execution creates exactly one attempt; a failed attempt leaves the request authorised with no automatic retry; a cycle produces one receipt.

standing_directives.rationale: Directive transitions are idempotent: activation replay returns the same state, withdrawal replay is a no-op, same-turn retry with a fresh event id does not duplicate.

workspace_actions.rationale: Every workspace action attempt is logged exactly once; an incomplete reply cannot duplicate a deferred external effect; a post-action staging failure is not exposed as retry-safe.

audio_stack.rationale: WAV, FLAC and MP3 round-trip through the production audio library and the audio module decodes each format with causal frequency behaviour.

clean_shutdown.rationale: The backend's exit status propagates unmasked through the launcher, browser lifetime is decoupled from the backend, and the backend is kept alive by a block-thread not a window loop.

dependency_availability.rationale: Every pinned production dependency (85) is installed at exactly its pinned version in the interpreter and the capability stacks import.

environment.rationale: The launcher requires the authenticated human binding and the project venv, and the runtime environment matches the manifest.

launch_anaxi_command.rationale: The real Launch Anaxi.command bash logic executes: bound-human gate, project-venv-only interpreter, preflight, renderer, sync, exactly one conversation start.

no_hidden_developer_bootstrap.rationale: The launcher never installs, downloads or bootstraps: only the preflight, sync and start run, network egress is impossible in the test run, and the embedding preflight fails closed rather than downloading.

offline_embedding_artifact_preflight.rationale: The local embedding artifact preflight passes offline with 384 dimensions, fails closed on an absent cache and on wrong dimension, and blocks the launch when it fails.

pdf_renderer.rationale: The bounded PDF page renderer produces PNG pixels through ordinary dispatch on this machine (PDFKit source fallback) and the launcher prepares/precompiles it before start.

production_path.rationale: The launcher is the ordinary path: it uses the project-local venv, the shared production backend for browser and desktop, and the conversation flag.

resource_sync.rationale: Public resources are reconciled before every launch, idempotently and fail-closed: the launcher runs the sync before the backend and stops if it fails.

restart.rationale: A second launch runs the identical sequence; durable state survives (recovery ceilings, roaming pause, canonical history); a duplicate launch does not start a second backend.

runtime_startup.rationale: The launcher starts exactly one backend, refuses duplicate/unrelated occupants, never opens the browser before readiness, and opens it exactly once at the exact URL.

canonical_x_appears.rationale: Canonical X is projected to the UI with exact text, canonical times and day order; a delayed recovered X appears directly beneath its H; a longer complete reply survives canonical and UI projection.

contained_failure_legible.rationale: A contained failure keeps the GUI alive, flags diagnostics honestly (success vs contained failure distinct), leaks no content, clears on the next success, and leaves controls usable.

controls_reflect_authoritative_state.rationale: Every control and indicator is derived from authoritative state: owner/request indicators, roaming status, recovery-needed status, lifecycle uncertainty, and controls run the same host transitions.

no_gui_only_truncation.rationale: The UI never truncates independently: reply length survives canonical and UI projection, footer stays a separate block, and submit rehydrates canonical times without sending display text to the driver.

no_hidden_inaccessible_result.rationale: Nothing is hidden from the owner: recovery lists every evidenced H (no top-N), Sleep control lists every actionable request, a recovered X is projected beneath its H, raw values stay available in diagnostics.

restart_reconnect_consistency.rationale: After restart or reconnect the UI shows the same authoritative state: rendering cannot mutate the owner, desktop and browser share one backend, roaming state is shared, durable pause is reconstructed, temporary unreadability resolves.

sleep_owner_control.rationale: The Sleep owner control lists every actionable request, uses the registered-human gate, needs confirmation with background stopped, and calls the cycle once with a receipt.

waking_recovery_owner_control.rationale: The recovery owner control enumerates every evidenced H, refuses scope mismatch before any consequential step, needs confirmation and stopped background, executes exactly one attempt; the GUI shows recovery-needed status and human resume recovers once authority is readable.

capability_not_evidence_of_need.rationale: The existence of a capability is not treated as evidence the subject needs it: affordances state optionality, no host counter or heartbeat interprets non-use, and public-space renderers carry no belief/feeling language.

correlated_not_independent_corroboration.rationale: Correlated evidence is not counted as independent: duplicate/wrong-actor durable records fail closed, exact duplicate derivations and duplicate selection ids add no weight, Sleep evidence-complete is not a watermark claim.

delivered_not_acted_upon.rationale: Delivery is distinct from action: recorded results are not delivery, only surviving units are marked delivered, inbound messages are never interpreted or auto-answered, delivery does not imply human attention.

external_read_does_not_widen_action.rationale: External reads are read-only and never grant action authority: GET only, no write verbs, no credentials threaded, injected instructions stay data, no automatic follow.

host_owns_facts_provenance_permissions_t.rationale: Facts, provenance, permissions, tools and runtime state are host-derived: the fixed capability table decides permission, canonical writers construct identity, models cannot forge them, Workspace tools are dispatched by the host.

no_assistant_prior_suppression.rationale: Assistant-style, apologetic, sycophantic, memory-commitment and retrieval-claim prose is delivered verbatim in conversation mode with no rewrite, suppression or regeneration.

no_fabricated_continuity_history.rationale: Continuity is never fabricated: incomplete pairs skipped, failed intervals not presented as delivered, recovery never fabricates X or uses replacement text, absent stores are 'not established'.

no_hidden_critic.rationale: No model or host critic reviews the subject's ordinary output: conversation mode makes exactly two model calls and delivers verbatim, every inference call site is registered and none is critic-shaped, the only output-screening regeneration is TASK-mode-only and the launcher starts CONVERSATION mode.

no_host_emotion_vector.rationale: No emotion/mood/affect/sentiment/valence/arousal/personality vector, score or governor exists anywhere in production code (AST scan proven sensitive to every construct shape).

no_host_personality_governor.rationale: Sampling and style derive only from the subject's own Kardia via a pure function; no personality/emotion governor construct exists in production code.

no_persistent_hidden_monologue_or_chain_.rationale: No hidden reasoning is persisted: Pass-1 free-form content is never durably stored or forwarded to Pass 2, thinking content is never written, generation runs with think disabled, roaming persists no free-form reasoning.

no_silent_current_h_rewrite.rationale: The current H is never silently rewritten: authenticated text becomes canonical H verbatim, the current message is delivered verbatim and never dropped for budget, recovery uses canonical stored text, submit sends canonical not display text.

alex_absence_not_sleep.rationale: Days without the human are elapsed time only: grounding never claims Sleep without an authorised cycle row, rendering writes nothing, background activity never invokes Sleep.

observability_not_autobiographical_memor.rationale: Diagnostics and traces are never memory: control trace is never referenced by dialogue/Kardia/hippocampus sources, telemetry component kinds are never retrieval-eligible, diagnostics record counts and sizes only, thinking content is never written.

pathways_not_organs.rationale: Capabilities are pathways the subject may choose, not organs the host exercises: every field is optional with a valid null, the subject may decline any pathway, and availability creates no obligation.

permission_not_obligation.rationale: Having permission never creates obligation: no usage counters, no countable gaps, no synthetic H for an unanswered outward act, no pressure language in affordances, and all-null choices are valid.

private_space_absolute.rationale: Private Space is absolute: no module in retrieval, dialogue, direction, journal, sleep, web or episode paths imports it, its content never reaches public windows/prompts/telemetry, ingest never discovers it, and the evidence machinery never names it.

represented_surface_fully_dispositioned.rationale: Introspects the production modules (typed acts and every request vocabulary, workspace resource classes, roaming acts, every model-call path, every owner GUI control) and fails unless each element maps to an inventory capability -- the denominator is what production represents, not what tests exist. Establishes accounting completeness only, not that each capability works.

retrieval_host_side_meaning_subject_side.rationale: Retrieval is host-side lexical/BM25 with no model client and no truth assertion; meaning is left to the subject: rendered items carry epistemic metadata only.

self_report_not_telemetry.rationale: A subject's claim of action is only prose: replies claiming sends/searches/journal writes/Sleep create no host record, ambiguous sends are uncertain, prose cannot authorise Sleep or create a directive.

subject_not_checkpoint_model_server.rationale: Model/checkpoint/server identity is provenance metadata: the subject actor id is model-independent, the waking model tag and Sleep model constant are independent provenance fields, and the provider seam is swappable without touching identity.

subject_supplies_interpretation_preferen.rationale: Interpretation and meaning are the subject's: no host semantic summary in Sleep evidence, no interpretive fields in the WMU schema, the instruction text contains no host-authored answer, wording never changes a typed act.

unknown_false_absent_failed_not_establis.rationale: The states stay distinct end to end: the completion law itself, WTR0 decision table (INELIGIBLE vs NOT_ESTABLISHED), residency observations, authority unknown vs paused, ambiguous send outcome, temporal grounding 'not established'.

audio_x_resource_selection.rationale: Music selected by the subject is measured mechanically through LISTEN/INSPECT_AUDIO with encounter provenance and truthful scope. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

caret_x_authority_retry.rationale: Discord authority, revocation and retry safety operate together end to end in the real waking path. Also: inbound carriage at production sizes.

direction_x_workspace.rationale: Direction state and Workspace actions coexist through the real Pass-1/Pass-2 path (request reaches every class, relinquish coexists once owned, competing substantive acts rejected).

directive_x_waking_context.rationale: An active directive is rendered into the real waking context as a pinned soft contribution and the capability affordance is present in a fully capable turn. Also: the directive text reaches the waking prompt.

external_info_x_waking.rationale: External results reach the waking context as tool data through canonical carriage with provenance and are delivered once. Also: at production sizes the fetched result reaches the subject.

family_shared_x_authority.rationale: Family/shared scope, principal binding and permission boundaries operate together through the real waking turn.

journal_x_principal_authorship.rationale: Journal entries carry the canonical actor id and family/owner-private scoping holds for Workspace availability.

null_refusal_x_each_capability.rationale: The null/refusal/decline choice is valid across every capability: direction, Workspace, external, Discord, directive, Sleep, background activity.

recovery_x_side_effects.rationale: Recovery replays the canonical H without duplicating external or durable effects.

recovery_x_ui.rationale: A recovered X appears directly beneath its H in the UI and the owner recovery surface enumerates and executes exactly one attempt.

resource_ingest_x_workspace.rationale: Ingested public resources are exactly what the Workspace serves: every source item of the collection is reachable through the ordinary action route (exact N==M), launcher sync precedes the backend. Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

restart_x_durable_state.rationale: Durable state across restart: direction trace, recovery ceiling, roaming pause, directive state, outward acts, journal, Discord ledger, launcher restart sequence.

sleep_x_memory_provenance.rationale: Sleep derivations land in the retrievable store with provenance and reach later waking through the real prepare path with markers intact.

vision_x_resource_selection.rationale: Photographs selected by the subject reach the vision route as real pixels with recorded encounters through selection (direction request for photographs, supervisor photograph view). Public distribution: the artifact is the synthetic public-resource assay over the deterministic generated collection (exact N==M); the production owner-collection record is not published.

workspace_x_provenance.rationale: Workspace actions produce canonical episode/encounter provenance with exact delivered text or bounded measurement and reconstruct by run id alone.

workspace_x_waking.rationale: The waking turn receives Workspace content through the supervised bridge: ordinary waking selects and receives substantive library content, the supervisor drives real actions end to end, and a fully capable turn fits and reaches the model. Also: at production sizes the waking->workspace->Pass 2 result reaches the subject.

containers_lifecycle.rationale: Containers (album/collection/playlist/shelf) can be created, listed, inspected, renamed and deleted.

every_attempt_recorded_without_content_l.rationale: Every attempt is logged; container content is never logged raw.

invalid_requests_fail_closed.rationale: Unknown types, empty names, missing containers/resources, traversal and unknown classes are refused truthfully.

no_model_or_network_dependency.rationale: The module imports no model or network code.

reachable_through_ordinary_typed_dispatc.rationale: Organization is reachable through the live typed action pathway and unknown actions fail closed; it never touches the private pathway.

references_lifecycle.rationale: References to existing resources can be added idempotently and removed.

source_originals_never_mutated.rationale: Removing a reference or deleting a container never touches the referenced source.

capability_boundaries_governed.rationale: The four resource classes are positively governed and unknown classes fail validation.

closed_query_vocabulary.rationale: Only the closed boundary query targets validate; malformed queries are rejected.

host_report_provenance_and_binding.rationale: A report is bound to its recorded query occurrence and cannot be rewritten or rebound.

hostframed_bounded_delivery.rationale: The rendered report is host-framed and bounded.

private_space_not_disclosed.rationale: The inspector has zero runtime dependency on Private Space.

report_reaches_subject_only_if_composed.rationale: Delivery is acknowledged only for a report that survived the real composition; a bare id assertion is refused.

unknown_absent_failed_not_established_st.rationale: Evidence-free complete negatives and inconsistent shapes are rejected; unresolved checks yield not-established causes.

canonical_response_persisted_before_arti.rationale: Custom-runner suite (pinned check count): the canonical waking turn is persisted before any artifact pass runs.

role_unchanged_and_not_an_output_governo.rationale: artifact_judgment stays a disclosed, host-triggered construction step over a human-authorized preservation request, before subject generation; it never sees or alters the subject's output. Defining modules are byte-identical to the independently verified 2598006 and pinned so any change forces re-review. Static/mechanical only; the semantic architecture question stays flagged, not decided.

signal_gate_integration.rationale: Custom-runner suite (pinned check count): POSITIVE invokes exactly one artifact model call; NEGATIVE/NO_SIGNAL/UNRECOGNIZED invoke none and create no artifact. Establishes mechanics only; whether a host-classified call is architecturally acceptable remains the flagged question, not decided here.

engineering_tooling_never_inspects_priva.rationale: Completion/assay tooling never names or traverses Private Space.

no_leak_to_other_surfaces.rationale: Ordinary library listing, dialogue, hippocampus, journal, direction trace and Sleep sources never import or reach the private workspace module.

observation_process_local_never_durable.rationale: The private observation is process-local, replaced not accumulated, and no durable trace file is written.

private_root_confinement.rationale: The private root is confined: traversal, absolute paths, symlink and rename escapes are rejected.

subject_private_operations_work.rationale: Write, append, read, rename and delete operate on exact content inside the private root.

caret_inbound_fifo_delivery.rationale: Received Caret messages reach the subject at production sizes; an oversized newest message never strands earlier ones and only carried messages are acknowledged.

fetched_page_reaches_subject_with_contin.rationale: A fetched page is delivered as a real window sized by measurement and its continue_with reaches the end of the extracted text. Also: all provider search results (not only the first few within a fixed bound) reach the subject at production sizes.

journal_progressive_read.rationale: A long journal entry is read progressively to its exact end with identity fields whole.

long_message_recovers_by_measurement.rationale: An overcounted long message recovers by bounded real measurement in the workspace stage as in ordinary waking.

measurement_never_lowers_a_deliberate_co.rationale: Re-costing lowers only what measurement proves, never above the byte bound, and never re-prices image admission costs.

no_composed_but_undelivered_kind.rationale: Every soft kind ordinary waking composes is read back after composition (structural guard for the composed-but-never-sent class).

operative_directive_reaches_the_prompt.rationale: An active directive is placed in the ordinary Pass-2 prompt and a pinned directive of ordinary length no longer fails every later turn.

ordinary_recent_dialogue_survives.rationale: At production sizes ordinary Pass 2 keeps the newest whole dialogue pairs instead of shedding all of them.

photograph_view_at_production_sizes.rationale: A photograph view completes with real pixels attached at production control-text sizes; the image keeps its own admission cost.

production_shaped_waking_completes_with_.rationale: The failing live shape (456-byte and 670-byte messages, use_workspace) completes through the real waking pass, dispatcher and canonical writer.

roaming_observation_window.rationale: Unattended roaming shows a truthful window of its last content encounter instead of dropping it.

true_overflow_still_fails_closed_without.rationale: A genuinely oversized hard floor still fails closed with zero WSP1 model calls, no action and no persistence.

workspace_collection_listing_walkable.rationale: A 151-entry collection listing delivers a real page and following continuations reaches every entry.
