workspace_library_read_window_and_contin.rationale: A 4000-character library read arrives as a truthful prefix with an accurate continuation, and a larger measured window when the provider can measure.

identity_independent_of_authority.rationale: Owner, family principal, external person and digital correspondent each get a canonical person with no change to owner/family authority, capability, visibility or authorization; a Step-2 correspondent's recorded identity grants no standing, principal role or actor.

owner_only_identity_binding.rationale: Stable identifiers map unambiguously to one person through owner-recorded, append-only ledgers; a username change never changes identity.

ambiguous_identity_fails_closed.rationale: Conflicting active bindings fail closed rather than choosing a person.

framed_utterance_retrieval_never_host_fa.rationale: Utterances keep speaker, source, time and a default frame; self-reports stay temporally situated, third-party reports stay attributed, corrections and contradictions coexist with their dates; retrieval frames each class, and Sleep derivations naming a person are never framed as that person's word.

later_identity_recontextualizes_without_.rationale: An unverified speaker established later is reported as such without rewriting the original event; Caret principal mapping resolves through the canonical person; an owner turn retrieves the prior utterance framed by the person and is unchanged without one.

no_relationship_fields_exist.rationale: Identity ledgers carry no relationship field and no recurrence diagnostic or relationship metric exists; standing requests are prospective-only records that can be revised or withdrawn.

clark_reflection_stays_clarks.rationale: Clark's reflection about a person stays Clark-authored with the named referent; it never becomes that person's fact.

unknown_source_converses_on_owner_opened.rationale: Through the real wake service and run_waking_turn, an unmapped Discord source on an owner-opened surface gets an occasion: no human H, no principal component, NULL-scope X carrying correspondent_source_ref, delivered marker written, identity shown as unverified with standing NONE.

closed_surface_holds_unknown_source.rationale: On a surface the owner has not opened, an unmapped source is held exactly as before and never reaches a prompt.

opening_is_prospective.rationale: Opening needs Family mode and the owner; a message sent before the door was opened is held NOT_ADMITTED.

owner_block_is_safety_not_meaning.rationale: An owner block holds the source and never alters Clark's standing; the owner panel shows standing read-only and has no standing control; a block after authoring stops dispatch at the side-effect boundary.

clark_controls_standing_db_enforced.rationale: The standing ledger rejects any non-Clark requester and any turn that did not carry Clark's typed standing choice (DB trigger); a typed choice binds standing to that exact turn.

standing_is_prospective_continuity_only.rationale: After Clark establishes standing, the next occasion carries the establishing exchange as continuity with that source only; it survives restart.

no_standing_no_continuity.rationale: Without standing a later occasion from the same source does not carry the earlier exchange.

correspondents_isolated_from_principals_.rationale: A second correspondent (same display name) and the owner never see a correspondent's continuity; a correspondent never sees the owner's private history (FS1 viewer check with positive control).

reply_follow_up_initiation_distinct.rationale: Reply (A) and Clark's null on an occasion; follow-up after silence (B) posts on a later occasion with no standing or initiation grant; independent initiation (C) from an owner turn needs standing and surface policy.

initiation_requires_standing_and_surface.rationale: Initiation without standing, or where the owner did not permit it, or unaddressed to an open surface, posts nothing and is disclosed to Clark; the lawful case posts exactly once.

revocation_ends_prospective_initiation.rationale: Clark's revocation ends prospective initiation (no further post, disclosed).

standing_never_widens_authority.rationale: Established standing is not a principal role, visibility grant or actor; identity binding grants no standing; authority is rechecked at dispatch.

general_not_person_or_channel_specific.rationale: A second owner-opened destination admits a second unknown source and the reply goes to that surface; two distinct sources are isolated.

restart_stable.rationale: Standing, continuity and retry exhaustion survive a fresh service instance.

only_typed_null_is_clarks_silence.rationale: Only the typed no_reply is recorded as Clark's choice; a blank completion or an unobtained Caret reply is a mechanical failure in every subsystem; repeated host resume failure is never withdrawal.

retry_exhaustion_durable_across_restart.rationale: Bounded occasion retries are durable; an exhausted occasion is never resurrected by a restart and is held RETRY_EXHAUSTED.

owner_close_reopen.rationale: The owner's reopen (with attempt watermark) makes an exhausted occasion deliverable again as the owner's act; the panel records close/reopen.

stranded_authored_send_completes_once.rationale: A committed send whose dispatch never started completes exactly once on the next tick; replay never duplicates or re-authors.

clark_withdrawal_is_second_authored_act.rationale: Clark is shown his pending send and may withdraw it by a typed choice; nothing is posted; his original words stay on record.

owner_closure_is_owner_act.rationale: A withdrawal without Clark's canonical choice is rejected by the DB; owner closure is recorded as the owner's act and never as withdrawal.

host_resume_exhaustion_not_withdrawal.rationale: Repeated failure to resume ends host retry and is recorded host_resume_failed, never Clark's withdrawal.

delivery_not_reception.rationale: Clark is told Discord confirmed the post and, explicitly, that whether anyone read it is not known.

clark_reaches_vault_through_ordinary_int.rationale: Through ordinary waking Pass 1 (use_workspace), WSP1 and the real canonical writer, Clark reads a shared note by its title and creates a note of his own; the task text describes the collection when offered.

list_and_windowed_read_with_provenance.rationale: Bounded listing without the internal store, host discovery then subject choice, windowed reads, frontmatter preserved verbatim.

authorship_decided_by_provenance_not_loc.rationale: Clark authorship is confirmed only by a canonical event in ANAXI's provenance plus an unchanged body hash; edited, unconfirmed, attributed, shared, host-marked and author-less notes are each reported as such; a folder name decides nothing. The owner's own notes are confirmed only through a canonical owner_vault_note record (owner-authored, path + body hash); a note merely claiming the owner stays a claim.

clark_creates_note_create_only_never_ove.rationale: A lawful create writes exactly one new file with provenance frontmatter bound to the canonical H; a colliding name leaves the existing note byte-identical and is disclosed.

exact_replay_creates_nothing_new.rationale: Replaying the same canonical message returns the already-created note; a conflicting replay writes nothing.

private_space_traversal_and_internal_sto.rationale: Symlink into Private Space, traversal, dot-store, and a vault configured inside Private Space are refused for read and create.

owner_private_only_never_roaming.rationale: Workspace (and so the vault) is offered only in the owner's principal-private session; unattended roaming never reaches it.

unavailable_vault_is_absent_not_empty.rationale: With no configured/existing vault the collection is absent from the surface, the task text and the menu; a call reports unavailability.

artifacts_carry_canonical_identity_and_n.rationale: Clark's signal-gated artifacts carry event_id/pipeline_id/content hash post-commit and never overwrite a note (first free suffix).

tests_and_probes_cannot_reach_the_real_v.rationale: While the test root is redirected the vault resolves inside it even if the owner's vault variable is set.
